messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Here’s a quick‑look at the long‑weekend periods that arise from Canada’s **federal statutory holidays** in 2023.  
(If you’re planning trips that cross provincial borders, keep in mind that some provinces add extra holidays—e.g., BC Day in British Columbia, Family Day in Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, and Ontario, etc.—which can also create long weekends.)

| Holiday | Date in 2023 | Long‑Weekend Span (Friday–Monday) |
|---------|--------------|-----------------------------------|
| New Year’s Day (observed) | Jan 2 (Mon) | Dec 31 2022 – Jan 2 2023 |
| Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario) | Feb 20 (Mon) | Feb 18 – Feb 20 |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 (Fri) | Apr 7 – Apr 9 |
| Victoria Day | May 22 (Mon) | May 20 – May 22 |
| Canada Day (observed) | Jul 3 (Mon) | Jul 1 – Jul 3 |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 (Mon) | Sep 2 – Sep 4 |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 (Mon) | Oct 7 – Oct 9 |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 (Mon) | Dec 23 – Dec 25 |

> **Note:**  
> • **BC Day** (first Monday in August) falls on Aug 7, 2023 → long weekend Aug 5–7.  
> • **Remembrance Day** (Nov 11, Thu) and **Boxing Day** (Dec 26, Tue) do **not** create long weekends in 2023.  

Feel free to plug these date ranges into your holiday‑planning app!
